text:
People Ops: heads up — please join me in welcoming Lina Chavez to Redwood as Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime! :tada:

People Ops: Lina starts Monday 2027-02-02 and will be taking over leadership for the Serving Runtime and Model Onboarding squads. This is a backfill for the role Markus has been covering while we searched.

Darius Cole: huge win — Lina brings 10+ years in low-latency systems and infra at two ML infra startups. excited to have her running runtime strategy.

Markus Lee: congrats Lina!! for context: I'll be transitioning to Director of Runtime Strategy and will focus on cross-team kernel & compiler partnerships. handover plan on the doc: <https://redwood.internal/docs/runtime-handover>

Lina Chavez: super excited to be here — thanks everyone. immediate priorities: meet the teams, review current rollout/backfills, and ship a simplified onboarding checklist for new model families. ping me for 1:1s, calendar link: `https://cal.redwood.ai/lina`

Jin Park: welcome Lina — can you take ownership of the A/B rollout policy for quantized models? that's been hanging in my queue.

Lina Chavez: yup, happy to. Jin — put the latest evals in the handover doc and I'll sync. also want to audit our canary thresholds.

Aisha Patel: congrats! folks in infra and SRE should know this affects oncall rotations — Markus, can you confirm who covers the runtime oncall during the transition?

Markus Lee: Samir will cover primary runtime oncall for the next 4 weeks, I'll be backup. updating rota now.

Samir Rao: confirmed, I have the weeks oncall calendar and will shadow this week.

Claire Nguyen: thanks Markus & Lina for the quick handover plan. People Ops — please add Lina to all engineering leadership groups and the Exec Reading list.

People Ops: added Lina to #eng-leads, #exec-reading, and SAML groups. welcome package and laptop order in progress. :package:

Oncall Bot: reminder — runtime oncall shift change scheduled for 2027-02-03 09:00 UTC (Samir primary).

Jin Park: quick Q — any changes to interview loop for runtime eng hires now that leadership shifted?

Lina Chavez: not immediately. I'll review the loop next week; if small changes are needed I'll coordinate with recruiting.

Markus Lee: leaving a short checklist for Lina in the handover doc: `- team org chart` `- current infra budget` `- outstanding infra tech debt JIRAs` `- pending model onboarding requests`

People Ops: thanks everyone — if you want to send a short welcome note to Lina, please do it in DMs or drop in #eng-random.

Claire Nguyen: :thumbsup:
